text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: It's been a while since somebody gave me a plushie like this.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: It really brings back good memories! I feel all warm and fuzzy inside.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Thanks a bunch. Let's keep making people proud.
